messages.author: bianca.barros.100770@quillpost.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the chapter events space. We have a full slate of tastings to plan for Parma and the surrounding dairies this year.

messages.author: elisa.cardoso.102010@mailhaven.example
messages.text: I checked with the venue in Sassari for our spring gathering. They can hold forty people comfortably if we confirm the date by next month.

messages.author: elodie.marchand.101628@larkhollowdairyinstitute.example
messages.text: The autumn tasting lineup is shaping up nicely. We have three new producers bringing younger alpine styles for the board review.

messages.author: bianca.barros.100770@quillpost.example
messages.text: Sponsorship interest is very strong this season, but venue costs have crept up across the board. We need to watch our catering budget closely.

messages.author: elisa.cardoso.102010@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Confirmed the spring visit route with the transport company. We will stop at four farms in Reggio Emilia before heading down to Parma.

messages.author: ines.iannone.101507@lakemail.example
messages.text: Given the rising production costs our members are facing, we should consider keeping the spring ticket prices flat this year.

messages.author: bianca.barros.100770@quillpost.example
messages.text: Agreed, Ines. Several small creameries are asking about hardship assistance, so let us coordinate with membership operations on that.

messages.author: camila.peixotoesposito.102115@mailhaven.example
messages.text: The new raw-milk aging rules are finally stabilizing our planning schedules. Producers are breathing a bit easier now.

messages.author: elisa.cardoso.102010@mailhaven.example
messages.text: For the autumn showcase, let us focus heavily on traceability and next-generation makers taking over family farms.

messages.author: bianca.barros.100770@quillpost.example
messages.text: That sounds like a solid direction, Jisoo. I will draft the final schedule and send it over to ICF staff for publication.
